title: Kargo debug configuration
description: Debug a Kargo program or its tests on the JVM with `kargo dap`.

request.description: `launch` runs a Kargo command under the debugger; `attach` attaches to a JVM started with `kargo run --debug`.

args.description: launch: the arguments of `kargo`, starting with `run` or `test`, such as ["run", "--bin", "server"] or ["test", "com.example.MathTest"]. Kargo adds `--debug` and, unless they name a target, `-t jvm`.

cwd.description: launch: the directory to run `kargo` in, relative to the project root; default: the project root.

env.description: launch: environment variables for `kargo` and the program.

port.description: attach: the port the JVM listens on.

hostName.description: attach: the host the JVM listens on.

timeout.description: How long to try to connect to the JVM, in milliseconds.

logLevel.description: How much kotlin-debug-adapter logs to the debug console.
